items.name: Sandwedge
items.desc: Breakfast sandwich with choice of bacon or ham with a fried egg*, cheese and thin layer of Dijon spread on a toasted croissant muffin.

items.name: Golfer Skillet
items.desc: Homestyle potatoes, bacon, grilled onion, bell peppers and spinach mixed with cheese and topped with egg(s).

items.name: Sweet Stack
items.desc: Griddled hot cakes topped with pecan granola, drizzled with warm maple cream (house-made with real maple syrup). Served with bacon. Choose 1 hot cake with 1 piece of bacon, or 2 hot cakes with 2 slices of bacon.

items.desc: With onions and peppers.

Soup of the Moment
items.desc: Always homemade.

items.name: Wedge Salad
items.desc: Iceberg lettuce wedge, bacon, blue cheese crumbles, diced tomato, pickled onion and toast.

sections.title: Lunch
sections.note: Served with choice of side: french fries, sweet potato fries, house chips, green salad or lemon-dill slaw. Gluten-free buns available.

items.name: Hazard Burger
items.desc: 1/3 pound smash burger patty*, American cheese, grilled onions, tomato, shredded lettuce, house pickles and Dijon spread. Bacon can be added.

items.name: Caddy Melt
items.desc: Patty melt with Reuben vibes: our smash burger patty*, Swiss cheese, grilled onion, kraut & 10K island sauce grilled on marble rye.

items.name: Bogey BLT
items.desc: Thick cut bacon, shredded lettuce & heirloom tomato on toasted wheat bread with mayo and balsamic glaze drizzle.

items.name: The Standby Deli
items.desc: House roasted turkey or deli ham, layered with Tillamook white cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onion, mild pepper rings and Dijon spread on wheat bread.

items.name: The Clubhouse
items.desc: House roasted turkey, ham, thick cut bacon, Tillamook white cheddar, lettuce, tomato, mayo, on a toasted burger bun.

items.name: Grilled Cheesy Par Threesy
items.desc: White cheddar, Swiss & American cheeses grilled on seasoned wheat bread. Ham or turkey can be added.

items.name: Fairway Veggie Sandwich
items.desc: House-made vegan patty (oat and lentil based) grilled with cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickled onion, on toasted wheat bread. Avocado can be added.

items.name: Birdie Basket
items.desc: Gluten-free chicken strips served with fries and slaw.

items.name: Putter Together Combo
items.desc: Cup of soup, green salad and toasted bread.

items.name: Out of Bounds Bowl
items.desc: Ask about our weekly changing salad & grain bowl with flavors that know no bounds! Gluten-free. Available weekdays.
